title: Equality of Fourier weight above a threshold
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the binary cube. The sum of squared vector Fourier coefficients of $f$ over indices whose support has size greater than $k$ equals the sum of squared Fourier coefficients of the corresponding function on the sign cube over subsets of size greater than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube
